mapper.select: SELECT APP_VER_NO, OS_TYPE, LATEST_VERSION, MIN_VERSION, UPDATE_MSG, STORE_URL, USE_YN, REGUSR_NO, DATE_FORMAT(REGIST_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS REGIST_DT, UPDFUSR_NO, DATE_FORMAT(UPDT_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS UPDT_DT FROM tb_app_version WHERE APP_VER_NO = #{APP_VER_NO}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_app_version ( OS_TYPE, LATEST_VERSION, MIN_VERSION, UPDATE_MSG, STORE_URL, USE_YN, REGUSR_NO, REGIST_DT, UPDFUSR_NO, UPDT_DT ) VALUES ( #{osType}, #{latestVersion}, #{minVersion}, #{updateMsg}, #{storeUrl}, #{useYn}, #{regusrNo}, NOW(), #{updfusrNo}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_app_version SET OS_TYPE = #{osType}, LATEST_VERSION = #{latestVersion}, MIN_VERSION = #{minVersion}, UPDATE_MSG = #{updateMsg}, STORE_URL = #{storeUrl}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, UPDFUSR_NO = #{updfusrNo}, UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE APP_VER_NO = #{appVerNo}
mapper.select: SELECT OS_TYPE, LATEST_VERSION, MIN_VERSION, UPDATE_MSG, STORE_URL FROM tb_app_version WHERE OS_TYPE = #{OS_TYPE} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY REGIST_DT DESC LIMIT 1
